name: bharat-tycoon
description: Bharat Tycoon - a free multiplayer property-trading board game where every map is a real place.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bt/engine && npm run build -w @bt/maps && npm run build -w @bt/server && npm run build -w @bt/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @bt/server" "npm run dev -w @bt/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bt/engine && npm run test -w @bt/maps && npm run test -w @bt/server
